title: Peeto Sar Azadaaro Mustafa ka Matam Hai
body:
Peeto sar azadaaro mustafa ka matam hai
Ghamzada isi gham se aaj saara alam hai
1. Kehrahi hai mayyat par rooke Fatima zehra
Yun na jao duniya se mujhko chor ke baba
Gham se shahzadi ka kya ajeeb alam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khak sar pe daale hai dekho shabbar o shabbir
Aur paa chadey khati hai gham se Zainab e dilgeer
Apne nana ka nouha unke lab pe paiham hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Roona payi jee bharke hayeh Fatima zehra
Dil pe shahzadi ke tha bohat bada sadmaa
Gham yateem hooney ka kya bhala koi kam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghar jalaya zehra ka hayeh ahley bidatt ne
Baap ka diya pursa beti ko ye ummat ne
Gham ka silsila paiham Fatima pe har dum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aye nazar karo matam Sarwar e do alam ka
Ho zubaan par nouha ab Hussain ke gham ka
Zakhme dil ke zehra ka bas yehi to marham hai
Azz:-sajjad nazar
